correctness.rationale: With the identically distributed independent continuous priorities specified in scope, the restriction of the random order to the current feasible set is uniform: a path sharing an occupied vertex can never regain eligibility, and each currently eligible path must be later than the last acceptance. Counting triples gives (X−1)/(S−2) for a step with ΔD=−1, and hence the stated drift and variance. The exact gamma recurrence gives conditional mean preservation of h(S)D at every accepted step with S>3; the cutoff avoids h(0). Its centered maximal fluctuation is O_P(N^(1/6)) by the O(N^(1/3)) sum of variance bounds. Off balance this is negligible against the deterministic N^(2/3) initial term. At early absorption above r_N≈√N, h(S)S≥h(r_N)r_N (the ratio between successive permitted levels s and s−3 is s/(s−2)>1). This barrier is of order N^(1/3) and early absorption is negligible in the critical window. The uncorrected quadratic variation divided by 3^(2/3)N^(1/3) tends to one by a progression Riemann sum. The imbalance correction is bounded in expectation by C N^(1/3) times the sum of s^(−2) above the cutoff; replacing absent steps by zero affects convergence in probability only on the negligible early-absorption event. The normalized maximal jump tends to zero, giving the martingale CLT. The remaining variance O(r_N^(1/3)) is negligible. Bounded remainders would give bounded stopped martingale, inconsistent with a positive limiting probability because the normalized Gaussian has no atom at zero. Thus |M_term|=h(U_N)U_N with high probability and gamma asymptotics give the 3/2 power of the absolute shifted Gaussian, with no missing factor of three. Boundedness gives the macroscopic expectation limit. The two path types with counts m and 4m indeed exactly pack K_(9m,6m), and δ=1/5. Replay: RESULT.md lines 31–139.
